description: This Java class 'PackingServices' provides service methods for managing packing operations within an order shipment process, including adding lines, bulk packing, incrementing package sequences, clearing lines, calculating shipping charges, and completing packing sessions.

classes.name: PackingServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static service methods for managing packing operations in shipment processing.

methods.name: addPackLine
methods.description: Adds or increases a line item in the packing session with specified product, quantity, weight, and instructions.

methods.name: packBulk
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple package lines based on selected items, quantities, weights, and package info.

methods.name: incrementPackageSeq
methods.description: Returns the next package sequence number from the packing session.

methods.name: clearLastPackage
methods.description: Clears the last package in the packing session and returns the next package sequence number.

methods.name: clearPackLine
methods.description: Removes a specific line from the packing session based on order and package details.

methods.name: clearPackAll
methods.description: Clears all packing lines in the current session.

methods.name: calcPackSessionAdditionalShippingCharge
methods.description: Calculates and sets additional shipping charges based on package weights and shipping info.

methods.name: completePack
methods.description: Finalizes the packing session, setting instructions, charges, weights, box types, and completing the shipment.

methods.name: setSessionPackageWeights
methods.description: Sets weights for packages in the session and calculates total shippable weight.

methods.name: setSessionShipmentBoxTypes
methods.description: Sets box types for packages in the session.
